![Settings.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/settings/devices/image/settings-b0379be16c215.svg) [**Settings**](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/settings#open) \> **Devices** list devices and their dimensions. You can select these devices from the **Dimensions** drop-down list in [device mode](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/device-mode#device).

## Add a device to the Devices list

To add a device to the list:

1. [Open Settings](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/settings#open).
2. In the **Device** tab, enable the checkbox next to a device you want to add.

   ![A list of enabled devices in the Devices tab.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/settings/devices/image/a-list-enabled-devices-7a68dd89b23e9.png)

## Add a custom device

If you don't see a device you want to test, add a custom one:

1. [Open Settings](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/settings#open).
2. In the **Device** tab, click **Add custom device**.
3. Specify the device details, for example, as shown on the screenshot:

   ![Pixel 7 Pro device details.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/settings/devices/image/pixel-7-pro-device-detail-1648375c55906.png)

   > [!IMPORTANT]
   > **Key point:** For more information on what to specify, see [User-Agent Client Hints](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/privacy-security/user-agent-client-hints).

4. Click **Save** . Your device is enabled by default and you can select it from the **Dimensions** drop-down list in [device mode](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/device-mode#device).

To edit or remove a custom device you added, click ![Edit.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/settings/devices/image/edit-5d6374da75e99.svg) or ![Delete.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/settings/devices/image/delete-08b041cd97a96.svg) buttons that appear on hover.
